policy.identity: exact AviList v2025b subspecies scientific name + source authority agreement (surname intersection; year equal when the source gives one)
policy.accepted_text: exactly one clean English name from the source English column; no translation, geography or Danish/German/Maori column is ever used
rejected: rows whose column count is not 4
Birds NZ bar entries whose English side cannot be established
names equal to the parent species name
the same name for several subspecies of one species
any disagreement between sources or with the manual references
